name: a2a-bridge
description: One-line inter-agent tasks over A2A for Hermes Agent. Wraps the bundled Hermes A2A platform plugin's outbound tools with reply formatting, audit-log lookup, and an approval gate before memory_share, credential_share, and config_write tasks. The plugin's actual tool registration is in-process (see plugin.yaml); this plugin.json declares the Agent Plugins v1 metadata so the package is discoverable in catalogs.
